label: TP
reason: User-supplied header name flows directly into HTML output via ESAPI.encodeForHTML without prior sanitization. Although encodeForHTML mitigates some XSS vectors, it does not fully sanitize all characters required for safe HTML attribute context (e.g., angle brackets used in attribute values like 'XSS" onclick="alert(1)' remain unescaped). The CodeQL path confirms direct flow from request headers to HTML rendering.
